integrity: The primary arXiv full text was inspected at the main halfspace theorem, the quadratic open problems, the vertex-index comparison, and the quadratic-form reformulation. The proof is all-dimensional and analytic; the bundled exact-rational checker is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to configurations with exactly two vertices on each of d independent lines through the origin, and to the analogous line-paired tight frames. It does not settle the two conjectures for arbitrary 2d-point configurations or determine the full vertex index of the Euclidean ball.
title: Line-paired cases of Ivanov's quadratic vertex conjectures
